Introducing the 2023 Diwali – Lakshmi 5g Pure Gold Bar. Celebrate Diwali, the globally revered Hindu festival of lights, with this exclusive design featuring the esteemed goddess Lakshmi. With individual serialization, be one of the lucky few to own this limited edition piece, with only 5,000 bars minted. Brought to you by MKS PAMP, and crafted exclusively for MTB. Secure this timeless investment today.
